_note: Episode 35 (S4E4), story version 2, Kabanata 35 "Ang Bitag". Manila, present day, Indio 35, six months a senator; the frame in an invented flood-control scheme (Hiraya Diking, invented firm; no real project, person, party or company); the witness scene is Manila, September 1907, outside the walls of Bilibid where Macario Sakay was hanged: the execution is not shown and Sakay is not drawn. Indio strings as in Episode 34 (mid-thirties, grey streaks; dark suit with no tie in office scenes). Every phone, paper, placard and screen carries only scribbles. Free-endpoint words avoided (brick, violet, museum, government building, legislative chamber, grand). Shots follow sentences.json; k90-k91 are montage extras.
